description.value: Kokanee Glacier Cabin is a remote backcountry alpine hut operated by the Alpine Club of Canada in the Kokanee Glacier area of British Columbia's Kootenay region. With a capacity of 13 guests and a mandatory reservation system, it serves mountaineers and wilderness travelers seeking a basecamp in the Selkirk Mountains. As a classic ACC hut, it offers basic wilderness shelter well beyond road access, making it an adventurous destination for self-sufficient cycle-tourers willing to venture into the alpine.
